note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All works, references, shelf marks and dates are fictional and illustrative; no citation is checked for accuracy and no legal conclusion is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Note 12 of a fictional journal article cites a treatise (p. 88); the treatise cites entry 3 of a harbour board minute book (fol. 14). The chain runs note → treatise → original, which the hand lifts out of its archive box.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional trail (a commentary citing a council register), and the supplied final state 'intermediate-only' — the chain stops at the intermediate reference, the original stays unopened in its box and the card records the reference as cited in the intermediate.

annotations.text: The trail stops at the commentary; the register itself is not opened
